products.name: Medium-Duty Electric Trucks and Chassis
products.description: Designs and manufactures all-electric Class 4-6 medium-duty trucks and stripped chassis, including step vans, box trucks, work trucks, and specialty vehicles. Vehicles are assembled at the company's facility or by contract manufacturers using domestic and global components.

products.name: Electric Buses (Shuttle and School)
products.description: Produces all-electric shuttle and school buses based on its Class 4 cab chassis, with upfitting for passenger and school bus applications. Vehicles are manufactured using proprietary chassis and upfitting processes.

products.name: Vehicle Upfitting Services
products.description: Offers upfitting services to customize electric trucks and buses for specialized applications, such as refrigeration, flat bed, utility, and other work truck configurations. Upfitting is performed in-house or through partners to meet specific customer needs.

products.name: Telematics and Fleet Data Management Solutions
products.description: Provides proprietary and third-party telematics systems (Workhorse Connect™ and Geotab) for real-time vehicle data, maintenance insights, operational analytics, and remote fleet management. Delivered as digital software and hardware solutions integrated with vehicles.

products.name: Charging Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Resells and integrates charging hardware, software, project advisory, implementation services, and infrastructure maintenance through third-party partners to support customer adoption of electric vehicles. Delivered as bundled solutions with vehicles or as standalone services.

products.name: Fleet Electrification Consulting and Support Services
products.description: Provides consulting, pilot programs, and deployment support to assist commercial fleets in transitioning to electric vehicles, including infrastructure planning, training, and incentive program navigation. Delivered through direct engagement and the Motiv Premier Partner Network.

products.name: Certified Dealer Training and Maintenance Program
products.description: Trains and certifies external dealers to safely repair and maintain electric vehicle components, providing ongoing support, training, and access to parts and infrastructure. Delivered through a formal dealer program to expand service coverage.

products.name: Campus Bookstore Management Services
products.description: Operation and management of physical and virtual bookstores for colleges, universities, and K-12 institutions, providing course materials and general merchandise through long-term contracts. Services include in-store and online sales, integration with campus systems, and customized merchandising.

products.name: Course Material Sales and Rentals
products.description: Provision of new and used print textbooks, digital textbooks, and publisher-hosted digital courseware for sale or rent, delivered through physical and virtual bookstores, as well as direct-to-student e-commerce platforms. Includes a guaranteed buyback program and dynamic pricing.

products.name: Affordable Access Course Material Programs (BNC First Day®)
products.description: Institutional and class-level programs (First Day Complete and First Day) that deliver required course materials (physical and digital) to students on or before the first day of class at below market rates, integrated with tuition or course charges, leveraging technology partnerships for seamless delivery.

products.name: General Merchandise Sales
products.description: Sale of collegiate and athletic apparel, custom-branded school spirit products, technology products, supplies, graduation products, convenience items, and other general merchandise through physical and online campus stores, including specialized e-commerce sites and event-driven pop-up shops.

products.name: Wholesale Textbook Distribution
products.description: Wholesale distribution of new and used textbooks, including national distribution for publisher consignment rental programs, utilizing a large automated facility to supply both internal retail stores and external institutional customers.

products.name: Inventory Management Hardware and POS Software
products.description: Sale and installation of inventory management hardware and point-of-sale software solutions for college bookstores, including on-site installation, user training, and technical support services.

products.name: Brand Marketing Programs
products.description: Operation of media and marketing campaigns targeting the college demographic on behalf of external brands, utilizing campus and online channels for integrated advertising, events, and sampling.

products.name: Cafés and Convenience Stores
products.description: Operation of customized cafés (including Starbucks Coffee® and regional roasters) and stand-alone convenience stores at campus locations, offering food, beverages, and grab-and-go options to students and faculty.

products.name: Credit and Charge Card Products
products.description: General purpose credit and charge cards offered to consumers, small businesses, and corporations, including a range of premium, cobrand, and rewards cards. These are primarily digital and physical payment products, delivered via proprietary and partner channels, and supported by technology infrastructure and customer service.

products.name: Card Rewards and Membership Benefits
products.description: A suite of rewards, loyalty, and membership benefits, including Membership Rewards, Amex Offers, cash-back, statement credits, lounge access, dining, travel, and lifestyle experiences, delivered digitally and through partnerships with merchants and service providers.

products.name: Banking and Financing Products
products.description: Deposit accounts (high yield savings, checking), consumer installment loans, business lines of credit, and non-card business-to-business (B2B) payment and cash/expense management solutions, provided through regulated banking subsidiaries and digital platforms.

products.name: Merchant Acquisition and Processing Services
products.description: Services for merchants to accept American Express cards, including onboarding, transaction processing, settlement, fraud prevention, and point-of-sale marketing, delivered via direct relationships and third-party partners, supported by proprietary technology and compliance infrastructure.

products.name: Payments Network Services
products.description: Operation of a global payments network that processes and settles card transactions, licenses third-party banks and institutions to issue American Express-branded cards and acquire merchants, and provides network access and technology integration.

products.name: Expense Management and Business Payment Solutions
products.description: Expense management software and business payment solutions for commercial clients, including digital tools for expense tracking, reporting, and integration with business processes, delivered via proprietary platforms and acquired technology (e.g., Center).

products.name: Travel and Lifestyle Services
products.description: Travel booking, reservation, and concierge services, including access to exclusive hotels, dining, entertainment, and experiences, delivered through digital platforms (e.g., Amex Travel App, Resy, Tock) and partnerships with travel and hospitality providers.

products.name: AMP Immunotherapy for mKRAS-driven Cancers (ELI-002)
products.description: A multivalent, off-the-shelf, lymph node–targeted AMP peptide immunotherapy manufactured via traditional pharmaceutical synthesis, designed to generate robust T cell responses against seven common KRAS mutations in solid tumors such as pancreatic, colorectal, and lung cancers. Delivered via subcutaneous injection, it leverages proprietary AMP technology to enhance lymph node targeting and immune activation.

products.name: AMP Immunotherapy for mutant BRAF-driven Cancers (ELI-007)
products.description: A preclinical, multivalent, lymph node–targeted AMP peptide immunotherapy developed to target 95% of BRAF gene mutations in solid tumors, manufactured using synthetic processes and designed to generate BRAF-specific T cell responses. Delivered via subcutaneous injection, it utilizes the AMP platform for lymph node targeting and immune activation.

products.name: AMP Immunotherapy for mutant TP53-expressing Cancers (ELI-008)
products.description: A preclinical, multivalent, lymph node–targeted AMP peptide immunotherapy developed to target TP53 hotspot mutations in solid tumors, manufactured via synthetic chemistry and designed to elicit TP53-specific T cell responses. Delivered by subcutaneous injection, it uses the AMP platform for lymph node targeting and immune activation.

products.name: AMP Platform Out-Licensing and Co-Development for Immunotherapy Applications
products.description: The proprietary AMP technology platform, designed for lymph node targeting of immunotherapeutic payloads, is offered for out-licensing, co-development, or partnership for applications including prophylactic vaccines, CAR-T and TCR-T cell therapies, and therapies for autoimmune disease. These are delivered as modular, synthetic conjugates adaptable to various therapeutic modalities.

products.name: Industrial Gases
products.description: Production and sale of atmospheric gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon) and process gases (hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, syngas, specialty gases) to customers in industries such as refining, chemicals, metals, electronics, manufacturing, medical, and food. Gases are produced at or near the point of use via cryogenic distillation or other processes and delivered through on-site plants, pipelines, bulk liquid, or packaged cylinders.

products.name: Clean Hydrogen Solutions
products.description: Development, engineering, construction, ownership, and operation of large-scale clean hydrogen projects, including blue hydrogen (with carbon capture) and green hydrogen (from renewable energy), primarily for industrial applications and heavy-duty transportation. Projects involve significant capital investment, engineering, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Industrial Gas Equipment
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of equipment for air separation, hydrocarbon recovery and purification, and transport and storage of liquid helium and hydrogen. Includes cryogenic and gas processing equipment, turboexpanders, and precision rotating equipment, sold to customers in chemical, petrochemical, oil and gas, and metals industries. Equipment is produced at company manufacturing sites with some components sourced from subcontractors.

products.name: Business Jet Aircraft
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells a full lineup of technologically advanced business jet aircraft under the Gulfstream brand, with manufacturing in the U.S. and global sales to individuals and corporations. Delivery includes physical aircraft production, outfitting, and certification.

products.name: Aircraft Services and Support
products.description: Provides maintenance, repair, overhaul (MRO), custom completion, refurbishment, and fleet management services for business aircraft globally, including a network of fixed-base operator (FBO) facilities and 24/7 support.

products.name: Nuclear-Powered Submarines
products.description: Designs, engineers, and constructs nuclear-powered submarines for the U.S. Navy, including Columbia-class and Virginia-class programs, involving advanced shipbuilding and systems integration at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Surface Combatant and Auxiliary Ships
products.description: Designs and builds surface combatant ships (e.g., Arleigh Burke-class destroyers) and auxiliary/support ships (e.g., Expeditionary Sea Base, fleet oilers) for the U.S. Navy and commercial customers, requiring large-scale shipyard operations and engineering.

products.name: Ship Repair, Modernization, and Lifecycle Support
products.description: Provides maintenance, modernization, and lifecycle support services for Navy and commercial ships, including engineering, logistics, and repair operations at major U.S. ports and overseas.

products.name: Land Combat Vehicles
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and upgrades wheeled and tracked military vehicles (e.g., Abrams tanks, Stryker vehicles, LAVs, Ajax, ASCOD, Piranha) for U.S. and allied armed forces, involving advanced engineering and large-scale production.

products.name: Weapon Systems and Munitions
products.description: Develops and manufactures weapon systems, artillery, energetics, and munitions (including large- and medium-caliber ammunition, Gatling guns, artillery projectiles, propellants, and missile subsystems) for air, land, and sea military applications.

products.name: IT Services and Digital Modernization
products.description: Provides IT services including cloud computing, cybersecurity, network modernization, AI/ML, application development, and digital transformation for defense, intelligence, and federal civilian agencies, delivered via large-scale contracts and innovation labs.

products.name: C5ISR Solutions (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance)
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and integrates C5ISR systems and subsystems for defense and intelligence customers, including secure communications, encryption, mission systems for platforms, and ISR solutions for all domains.

products.name: Autonomous and Unmanned Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and integrates unmanned undersea vehicles (UUVs), unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) subsystems, and autonomous capabilities for military and intelligence applications, leveraging specialized manufacturing and integration centers.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling Services and Recovered Battery Materials
products.description: Aqua Metals uses its proprietary AquaRefining process, a modular, electricity-powered, electro-hydrometallurgical technology, to recycle lithium-ion batteries and recover high-purity battery materials such as lithium carbonate, lithium hydroxide, nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese. The process is conducted at pilot-scale facilities and is designed for future commercial deployment, producing materials for resale into battery manufacturing supply chains and global metals markets.

products.name: Lead-Acid Battery Recycling Services and Recovered Lead Products
products.description: Aqua Metals developed and previously operated a smelterless, electro-hydrometallurgical process for recycling lead-acid batteries, producing recycled lead for sale into metals markets. The process uses proprietary solvents and electrochemical methods to recover high-purity lead from battery paste, with lower emissions and waste compared to conventional smelting.

products.name: Licensing and Deployment of AquaRefining Technology
products.description: Aqua Metals offers its proprietary AquaRefining technology platform, including equipment and process know-how, for licensing, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships to enable third parties to establish battery recycling operations using its electro-hydrometallurgical process. This includes the potential sale of modular Aqualyzer systems and related software for facility deployment.

products.name: Scrubwear
products.description: Technically advanced, comfortable, and functional scrubs designed for healthcare professionals, manufactured using proprietary fabrics and sold primarily through direct-to-consumer digital platforms and physical retail stores.

products.name: Non-Scrubwear Healthcare Apparel
products.description: A range of apparel products designed to complement scrubs, including outerwear (lab coats, jackets, vests, fleeces), base layers (underscrubs, compression socks, leggings), and loungewear, produced with a focus on comfort and functionality for healthcare professionals.

products.name: Healthcare Footwear
products.description: Footwear specifically designed for healthcare professionals, including shoes developed in partnership with New Balance, offering support, traction, cushion, and moisture-repellent qualities, distributed via digital and physical channels.

products.name: Healthcare Accessories
products.description: Accessories tailored for healthcare professionals, such as scrub caps, lanyards, badge reels, bags, baseball caps, and beanies, produced to meet the practical needs of the healthcare environment.

products.name: Custom Embroidery and Personalization Services
products.description: Embroidery and heat press services offered on a variety of products, performed in a technology-enabled workshop to provide personalized apparel for healthcare professionals and institutions.

products.name: Institutional Uniform Solutions (TEAMS B2B Platform)
products.description: A B2B platform enabling healthcare institutions and administrators to order and standardize uniforms for their organizations, streamlining the procurement of FIGS products for institutional customers.

products.name: Entertainment Publicity and Marketing Services
products.description: Comprehensive publicity and marketing services for entertainment, music, hospitality, lifestyle, and non-profit clients, including public relations, strategic communications, social media, influencer marketing, and celebrity booking. Delivered through specialized agencies with in-person and digital expertise.

products.name: Influencer Marketing and Talent Management
products.description: Management of influencer talent and execution of paid and organic influencer marketing campaigns for brands, including event ideation and production. Services are delivered digitally and in-person, leveraging a roster of over 300 influencers across multiple platforms.

products.name: Celebrity Booking and Special Event Services
products.description: Booking celebrities and influencers for brand campaigns and events, including talent strategy, event activation, guest list curation, and brand amplification. Delivered through in-person event management and digital coordination.

products.name: Content Production (Film, Television, and Digital)
products.description: Development, production, and distribution of feature films, television programs, and digital content, including original and co-produced projects. Requires physical production, creative talent, and distribution partnerships.

products.name: Live Event Production and Promotion
products.description: Development, production, and promotion of live events such as movie premieres, award shows, music and food festivals, leveraging celebrity and influencer engagement. Delivered through in-person event management and marketing campaigns.

products.name: Consumer Product Development and Marketing
products.description: Development and marketing of consumer products, often in partnership with celebrities and influencers, across categories such as liquor, cosmetics, skin care, fashion, supplements, and wellness. Involves product conception, branding, and marketing campaigns.

products.name: Middle-Market Debt Financing
products.description: Origination and investment in leveraged loans and other debt securities (primarily senior secured loans) to performing middle-market companies, typically through privately negotiated transactions. These are physical financial products requiring significant capital, underwriting, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Equity Investments in Portfolio Companies
products.description: Provision of equity capital (including preferred or common stock, warrants, and options) to portfolio companies, often in connection with debt investments. These are negotiated, illiquid investments requiring due diligence and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Distressed Debt Investments
products.description: Investment in the securities and obligations of distressed and bankrupt issuers, including defaulted debt, typically acquired at a discount. These are speculative, high-risk financial products requiring specialized expertise in restructuring and workouts.

products.name: Opportunistic Investments
products.description: Investments in a broad range of debt and equity securities, including public equities, emerging market debt, and structured finance vehicles such as CLOs, outside the core middle-market focus. These are made on an opportunistic basis and are not the primary business line.

products.name: Small Business Investment Company (SBIC) Lending
products.description: Provision of long-term loans and equity investments to qualifying small businesses through an SBA-licensed SBIC subsidiary, leveraging regulatory capital and government-backed debt. This involves regulatory compliance and is targeted at smaller enterprises.

products.name: K-12 School-as-a-Service
products.description: An integrated, comprehensive package for operating full-time virtual K-12 schools, including curriculum, technology systems, instruction, and support services, delivered primarily to public and private schools, districts, and charter boards. Requires proprietary digital platform, certified teachers, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: K-12 General Education Curriculum and Courses
products.description: Digital core subject curriculum and courses (math, English, science, history) for K-12 students, delivered online as stand-alone products or as part of broader solutions. Requires proprietary content development and digital delivery systems.

products.name: K-12 Career Learning Programs
products.description: Online career-focused courses and pathways for middle and high school students, including industry certifications, college credits, and work-based learning experiences in fields like IT, healthcare, and business. Delivered digitally, often integrated with general education.

products.name: Online Private Schools (Tuition-Based)
products.description: Full-time, tuition-based online private schools for K-12 students, including international students, offering flexible, English-based education and college preparatory programs. Delivered via proprietary digital platform with certified teachers.

products.name: Supplemental and Consumer Educational Products
products.description: Direct-to-consumer digital educational products, including complete curriculum, individual courses, tutoring, and enrichment materials for K-12 students, used for homeschooling, credit recovery, summer school, and academic supplements. Delivered online or as physical kits.

products.name: Adult Career Training Programs
products.description: Post-secondary training programs for adults in high-demand fields such as software engineering and allied healthcare, leading to industry certifications. Delivered online (self-paced or immersive) or in-person, sold to consumers, employers, and government agencies.

products.name: Enterprise Talent Development Solutions
products.description: Customized talent development and upskilling programs for employers and government agencies, leveraging digital and in-person training in technology and healthcare fields. Delivered via proprietary platforms and tailored to organizational needs.

products.name: Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) Services
products.description: Comprehensive third-party evaluation, inspection, and certification of products, components, and systems for safety, performance, and regulatory compliance, delivered through a global network of laboratories and technical experts. Services include certification testing, ongoing certification, and non-certification testing across industrial and consumer markets.

products.name: Software Solutions for Compliance, Supply Chain, and Sustainability
products.description: Cloud-based and licensed software (SaaS and on-premise) enabling customers to manage regulatory requirements, supply chain transparency, product stewardship, chemicals management, ESG data and reporting, and EHS training and compliance. Delivered as standalone or integrated solutions, including the ULTRUSTM platform.

products.name: Advisory and Technical Consulting Services
products.description: Expert advisory and consulting services supporting customers in managing safety, compliance, regulatory risk, and sustainability programs, including technical training, audits, and field engineering. Delivered by specialized technical and regulatory experts.

products.name: Wholesale Distribution of Grocery and Non-Food Products
products.description: UNFI distributes a broad assortment of grocery and non-food products, including natural, organic, specialty, conventional, and multicultural items, to retailers across North America through a network of distribution centers. Products are sourced from suppliers and delivered via a multi-tiered logistics system.

products.name: Private Label and Owned Brand Products
products.description: UNFI develops and sells a portfolio of private label and owned brand products across multiple categories, including grocery, perishables, frozen, health and beauty care, and pet foods, distributed through wholesale and retail channels.

products.name: Retail Grocery Stores
products.description: UNFI operates retail grocery stores under banners such as Cub Foods and Shoppers, offering a full range of grocery, general merchandise, health and beauty care, and pharmacy products directly to consumers. These stores are supplied by UNFI's distribution centers.

products.name: Bulk and Foodservice Products
products.description: UNFI supplies bulk and foodservice products, including ingredients and prepared foods, to foodservice operators and retailers, leveraging its distribution network and procurement scale.

products.name: Natural and Organic Snack Food Manufacturing
products.description: Through its Woodstock Farms Manufacturing subsidiary, UNFI manufactures, packages, and distributes natural and organic snack items such as nuts, dried fruit, seeds, trail mixes, granola, and confections, sold in bulk and private label formats to retailers.

products.name: Digital and Professional Services for Retailers
products.description: UNFI provides digital and professional services to wholesale customers, including shelf and planogram management, pricing strategy, store layout and design, point-of-sale solutions, data hosting, automation tools, and administrative back-office solutions, delivered via proprietary platforms and partnerships.

products.name: Retail and Supplier Marketing Services
products.description: UNFI offers marketing services to retailers and suppliers, including consumer and trade marketing programs, digital marketing, loyalty programs, eCommerce capabilities, and a retail media network for targeted advertising, designed to increase sales and brand visibility.

products.name: eCommerce Marketplace Platform
products.description: UNFI operates Marketplace by UNFI, a business-to-business digital eCommerce platform that connects emerging brands with retailers, enabling online ordering and access to a broader assortment of products.

products.name: Surgical Drivers and Shavers
products.description: Design, development, and manufacture of autoclavable, battery-powered and electric, multi-function surgical drivers and shavers, primarily for orthopedic, thoracic, and craniomaxillofacial (CMF) markets. Products are machined and assembled in company facilities and sold to medical device distributors and OEMs.

products.name: Medical Device Repairs
products.description: Repair services for handheld medical devices and accessories, performed in-house at company facilities, supporting both products manufactured by Pro-Dex and customer-owned devices.

products.name: Rotary Air Motors
products.description: Manufacture and sale of rotary air motors for industrial and scientific applications, produced in the same facilities as medical devices and sold to distributors and end users in various industries.

products.name: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) and Prototype Services
products.description: Provision of engineering design and prototype development services, often as part of development contracts with customers, including billing for NRE services related to new product development.

products.name: Dental and Component Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of dental and component products, representing a minor portion of total sales, produced using the company's machining and assembly capabilities.

products.name: Wholesale Voice and Messaging Services
products.description: Carrier-scale telecommunications services providing global voice termination and SMS routing, delivered via a cloud-based platform with AI-driven routing, automation, and real-time billing systems. Requires regulated infrastructure, carrier interconnects, and large-scale data processing.

products.name: AI-Enabled Communications Infrastructure Platform
products.description: Integrated platform offering communications infrastructure, including edge computing and data processing assets, supporting low-latency, scalable compute and storage for communications and transaction-related data. Delivered via proprietary and licensed technology assets.

products.name: Communications-Driven Transaction Workflows
products.description: Emerging suite of services enabling messaging-based payment workflows, transaction confirmations, financial notifications, and cross-border transaction messaging, leveraging telecom infrastructure and strategic fintech partnerships. Delivered digitally and integrated with communications channels.

products.name: AI-Driven Communications Workflow Software
products.description: Software platforms (such as AQUA AI and Leadnova.ai) that automate and structure communications into business workflows, supporting conversational engagement, automation, and integration with data-driven processes. Delivered as digital applications and platforms.

products.name: Fiberglass In-Ground Swimming Pools
products.description: Manufactured using a seven-layer composite process with fiberglass, carbon fiber, and Kevlar, these pools are produced in company-owned facilities and delivered directly to dealers for installation in residential settings. They are customizable in shape, color, and features, and are installed rapidly compared to concrete pools.

products.name: Custom Vinyl In-Ground Swimming Pools (Packaged Pools)
products.description: Fully customizable in-ground pools constructed with either non-corrosive steel or composite polymer wall systems and finished with vinyl liners. Manufactured in specialized facilities using advanced molding and metal processing equipment, these pools are distributed through a national network and installed by dealers.

products.name: Automatic Safety Pool Covers
products.description: Motorized, build-to-order safety covers for in-ground pools, manufactured using machining, cut/sew, sonic welding, and assembly operations. These covers enhance safety, reduce maintenance, and are compatible with pools of various shapes, sizes, and materials.

products.name: All-Season Pool Covers
products.description: Custom-designed mesh and solid covers for off-season pool protection, manufactured using precision cutting and reinforced stitching. These covers are made to order for any pool shape or size and provide recurring replacement revenue.

products.name: Vinyl Pool Liners
products.description: Customizable vinyl liners for in-ground pools, produced using sonic and heat welding technologies. Liners are required for vinyl pools and are replaced every eight to ten years, providing recurring revenue.

products.name: Epetraborole Therapeutics
products.description: Oral small-molecule therapeutics based on boron chemistry, developed for the treatment of polycythemia vera (PV), Mycobacterium abscessus complex lung disease, melioidosis, and tuberculosis. These drugs are produced via third-party contract manufacturing and delivered as oral medications following regulatory approval.

products.name: AN2-502998 Therapeutics
products.description: Oral small-molecule therapeutic developed for the treatment of Chagas disease, produced using proprietary boron chemistry and manufactured by third-party contractors. Delivered as an oral medication, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics (PI3Kα and ENPP1 Inhibitors)
products.description: Preclinical small-molecule therapeutics targeting PI3Kα and ENPP1 for the treatment of solid tumors, developed using boron chemistry. These are intended for future clinical development and, if approved, would be delivered as oral or injectable drugs.

products.name: Pumps and Pump Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and services highly custom engineered pumps, pre-configured industrial pumps, pump systems, and auxiliary systems for critical flow control applications. Production involves precision engineering, physical manufacturing in global facilities, and is delivered as original equipment or through aftermarket support.

products.name: Mechanical Seals and Sealing Systems
products.description: Manufactures and sells mechanical seals and sealing systems, including gas-lubricated seals, for rotating equipment to prevent leakage and emissions. Products are physically manufactured and sold both as original equipment and as replacement parts.

products.name: Valves and Valve Automation Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes engineered-to-order and configured-to-order isolation valves, control valves, valve automation products, and related equipment. Products are physically manufactured and can be customized for specific flow control environments.

products.name: Aftermarket Equipment Services
products.description: Provides comprehensive aftermarket services for flow control equipment, including installation, advanced diagnostics, repairs, maintenance, retrofits, and asset management. Services are delivered through a global network of Quick Response Centers and require in-person technical labor and expertise.

products.name: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) Solutions (RedRaven)
products.description: Offers proprietary IIoT solutions for equipment monitoring, asset health diagnostics, and remote condition monitoring, integrating sensors, edge devices, and software to optimize flow control operations. Delivered as digital services and hardware/software packages to industrial customers.

products.name: Energy Efficiency and Decarbonization Solutions (Energy Advantage Program)
products.description: Provides holistic flow control solutions and engineering expertise to help customers increase energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and lower operational costs, including systematic evaluation and optimization of pump and valve power consumption. Delivered as consulting, analysis, and implementation services.

products.name: Programmatic Advertising Platform
products.description: A self-service, AI-enabled software platform that allows ad buyers to plan, execute, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across multiple channels and devices. The platform integrates with ad exchanges, publishers, and data partners, and is delivered as a cloud-based SaaS solution.

products.name: Data Marketplace and Management Services
products.description: A marketplace and suite of tools providing access to third-party and proprietary data sets for campaign targeting, optimization, and measurement. Delivered digitally through the platform, these services enable clients to ingest, manage, and utilize data for more effective advertising.

products.name: Advanced Reporting and Analytics Tools
products.description: A set of digital tools and integrations that provide real-time, granular reporting and analytics on advertising campaign performance, audience characteristics, and inventory quality. Delivered through the platform interface and APIs.

products.name: APIs and Customization Services
products.description: Application programming interfaces (APIs) and related services that allow clients to customize, extend, and integrate the platform’s functionality into their own systems, including building proprietary tools and user interfaces.

products.name: Identity and Privacy Solutions (Unified ID 2.0 and EUID)
products.description: Open-source identity frameworks and privacy tools that transform personal identifiers into pseudonymous advertising IDs, enabling privacy-compliant targeting and measurement across digital campaigns. Delivered as integrated services within the platform.

products.name: Publisher Inventory Access Solutions (OpenPath, PubDesk)
products.description: Tools and interfaces that provide direct, transparent access to premium digital advertising inventory from publishers, including dashboards and direct connections for inventory discovery and transaction. Delivered digitally through the platform.

products.name: Supply Chain Transparency Tools (OpenSincera, OpenAds)
products.description: Open-source and proprietary tools that provide advertisers and publishers with detailed metadata and transparency into the digital advertising supply chain, ad experiences, and auction integrity. Delivered as digital services integrated into the platform.

products.name: Home Goods E-Commerce Platform
products.description: An online marketplace offering a vast selection of furniture, décor, housewares, and home improvement products from approximately 20,000 suppliers, delivered directly to consumers and businesses via a proprietary logistics network. Products are sold through multiple branded websites and a mobile app, with digital merchandising and personalized shopping experiences.

products.name: Physical Retail Stores for Home Goods
products.description: Brick-and-mortar retail locations that allow customers to experience and purchase furniture, décor, housewares, and home improvement products in person, with in-store services and curated product selections reflecting the online assortment.

products.name: Logistics and Fulfillment Services for Suppliers
products.description: Logistics solutions including warehousing, inventory forward-positioning, freight forwarding, and last mile delivery, offered to suppliers to enable faster and more reliable delivery of home goods to customers, leveraging proprietary networks such as CastleGate and Wayfair Delivery Network.

products.name: Supplier Media and Merchandising Services
products.description: Supplemental digital media and merchandising services provided to suppliers, including sponsored content and data analytics, to enhance product visibility and sales on Wayfair’s e-commerce platform.

products.name: Private Label Credit and Rewards Programs
products.description: Private label and co-branded credit cards, as well as a membership rewards program, offering customers financing solutions, cash back, free shipping, and exclusive sales to encourage repeat purchases and build loyalty.

products.name: Branded Value-Added Meat Products
products.description: Processed and packaged pork, turkey, beef, and chicken products sold under various brands through retail, foodservice, and international channels. Production involves physical manufacturing at company-owned and co-manufacturer facilities, with distribution via multiple channels.

products.name: Branded Nut Products
products.description: Processed and packaged nut products, including peanuts and cashews, sold under brands such as Planters and Skippy, distributed through retail and other channels. Production requires sourcing of nuts, processing, and packaging.

products.name: Branded Prepared and Packaged Food Products
products.description: A variety of shelf-stable and refrigerated prepared foods, such as chili, stews, Mexican foods, and spreads, sold under brands like SPAM, Dinty Moore, Wholly, and MegaMex Foods. These products are manufactured, packaged, and distributed through retail, foodservice, and international channels.

products.name: Avexitide
products.description: A first-in-class GLP-1 receptor antagonist developed as a subcutaneous injectable therapy for post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH) and congenital hyperinsulinism (Congenital HI). It is manufactured using peptide synthesis and delivered via daily injection, requiring regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical distribution.

products.name: AMX0035
products.description: An oral, fixed-dose combination of sodium phenylbutyrate and taurursodiol, developed to treat neurodegenerative diseases such as Wolfram syndrome. It is produced through pharmaceutical formulation and delivered as an oral medication, requiring regulated manufacturing and clinical distribution.

products.name: AMX0114
products.description: An investigational antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapy targeting calpain-2 for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). It is manufactured using oligonucleotide synthesis and delivered via intrathecal administration, requiring specialized pharmaceutical production and clinical infrastructure.

products.name: AMX0318
products.description: A novel, long-acting GLP-1 receptor antagonist in preclinical development for PBH and other rare diseases. It is being developed for extended dosing intervals and is produced via peptide-based drug discovery and synthesis, requiring advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing and preclinical validation.

products.name: Precision Logistics Services for Time and Temperature Sensitive Shipments
products.description: End-to-end logistics management for perishable and time-sensitive products, utilizing a proprietary software platform for predictive analytics, real-time shipment tracking, weather and traffic monitoring, and last-mile resolution, delivered via a secure web portal and supported by a U.S.-based service center. Services include pre-transit packaging consulting, in-transit monitoring, post-delivery reporting, and exception management, primarily for healthcare, food, and agriculture industries.

products.name: Authentication and Brand Protection Services
products.description: Anti-counterfeit and brand protection solutions for brand owners, enabling them to deter counterfeit and diversion activities. These services are technology-enabled and delivered to external customers, though the company is not actively pursuing new business in this segment but continues to service existing customers.

products.name: Seralutinib
products.description: An investigational inhaled small molecule kinase inhibitor (PDGFR, CSF1R, c-KIT) developed and manufactured via third-party contract manufacturing, delivered through a portable inhalation device, for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD).

products.name: RT234 (Inhaled, On-Demand PDE5 Inhibitor)
products.description: An investigational inhaled, as-needed (PRN), dry-powder formulation of vardenafil (a PDE5 inhibitor), manufactured by Respira Therapeutics, intended for rapid, on-demand symptom relief in PAH and PH-ILD, delivered via inhalation device.

products.name: ANKTIVA (nogapendekin alfa inbakicept)
products.description: A first-in-class IL-15 receptor superagonist antibody-cytokine fusion protein, manufactured using biologic processes and delivered via injection, commercialized for the treatment of BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) and, in combination with checkpoint inhibitors, for metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

products.name: CAR-NK Cell Therapies (t-haNK platform)
products.description: Off-the-shelf, allogeneic chimeric antigen receptor natural killer (CAR-NK) cell therapies, including PD-L1 and CD19 targeted variants, manufactured from cell lines and delivered as outpatient infusions for the treatment of solid tumors and non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

products.name: M-ceNK Cell Therapies
products.description: Autologous and allogeneic memory-like cytokine-enhanced natural killer (M-ceNK) cell therapies, manufactured from donor or patient lymphocytes via apheresis and ex vivo cytokine priming, cryopreserved and administered for advanced solid tumors and ovarian cancer.

products.name: Adenovirus-Vectored Therapeutic Vaccines (hAd5 platform)
products.description: A portfolio of adenovirus serotype 5 (hAd5) vector-based vaccines, manufactured using viral vector technology, targeting tumor-associated antigens (TAAs) and neoantigens for oncology (e.g., CEA, MUC1, Brachyury, PSA, HPV E6/E7) and infectious diseases (e.g., HIV, COVID-19).

products.name: Recombinant BCG (rBCG) Supply for Bladder Cancer
products.description: Distribution of recombinant BCG, manufactured by Serum Institute, for use in combination with ANKTIVA to address BCG shortages in the treatment of NMIBC, provided under expanded access programs and clinical trials.

products.name: Cancer BioShield Platform (multi-modal immunotherapy)
products.description: A platform integrating cytokine fusion proteins, adenovirus-vectored vaccines, and NK cell therapies to activate innate and adaptive immune responses against cancer and infectious diseases, delivered via biologic manufacturing and cell therapy processes.

products.name: INT230-6 (Intratumoral Cancer Therapeutic)
products.description: A novel, patented anti-cancer drug formulation for direct injection into solid tumors, composed of cisplatin, vinblastine sulfate, and an amphiphilic molecule (SHAO) that enables dispersion and absorption within tumors. Manufactured as a water-based injectable product, it is delivered via intratumoral injection to kill cancer cells locally and induce systemic immune activation. The product is produced under cGMP conditions and is being developed for multiple solid tumor indications, including metastatic and presurgical settings.

products.name: Natural Resource Royalties
products.description: The company acquires ownership of real estate, infrastructure, permits, and properties containing coal and other natural resources, monetizing them by collecting royalties from extraction and mining activities. This involves physical asset ownership and regulated resource extraction.

products.name: Intellectual Property Investments in Resource Technologies
products.description: The company invests in intellectual property related to the refining of elements and critical minerals, supporting resource industries through technology and IP ownership. Delivery is via financial investment and licensing.

products.name: Infrastructure Support Services
products.description: Through subsidiaries such as RMC Environmental Services LLC, the company invests in and operates service businesses that support infrastructure expansion, involving in-person labor and regulated services.

products.name: XTRAC Excimer Laser Systems
products.description: Medical devices that deliver targeted ultraviolet B (UVB) light therapy for the treatment of autoimmune and inflammatory dermatologic conditions such as psoriasis, vitiligo, atopic dermatitis, and leukoderma. These systems are manufactured at the company's facility and are delivered to physicians primarily under a recurring revenue model in the U.S. and as equipment sales internationally.

products.name: VTRAC Lamp Systems
products.description: Medical devices that use ultraviolet B (UVB) lamp technology to treat dermatologic conditions such as psoriasis and vitiligo. VTRAC systems are marketed exclusively in international markets through distributors and are manufactured by the company.

products.name: TheraClear Acne Therapy System
products.description: A medical device that combines vacuum and broadband light technology to treat mild to moderate inflammatory, comedonal, and pustular acne. The system is used in-office by dermatologists and treatments are performed in approximately 10 minutes.

products.name: Agricultural Irrigation Systems
products.description: Manufacture and marketing of center pivot, lateral move, and hose reel irrigation systems, including controls and integrated technology, primarily for agricultural use. These systems are physically manufactured and distributed globally through dealers and direct sales.

products.name: Irrigation Technology Solutions
products.description: Development and sale of proprietary digital technology solutions for irrigation management, including remote monitoring, automation, scheduling, and data analytics, delivered via cloud-based platforms and mobile applications. These are sold as software subscriptions and integrated with physical irrigation systems.

products.name: Irrigation System Parts and Components
products.description: Manufacture and sale of repair and replacement parts for irrigation systems, including large diameter steel tubing, chemical injection systems, flow meters, weather stations, and soil moisture sensors. These are physically produced and distributed to support installed irrigation equipment.

products.name: Moveable Barrier Systems (Road Zipper System)
products.description: Manufacture, sale, and leasing of moveable concrete and steel barrier systems and barrier transfer machines for roadway lane management and construction safety. These are large, physically manufactured systems deployed on highways and construction sites.

products.name: Crash Cushions
products.description: Manufacture and sale of redirective and non-redirective crash cushion systems for highway safety, designed to absorb impact at hazardous locations. These are physically manufactured and distributed through a network of distributors.

products.name: Specialty Barriers and Barrier Gates
products.description: Manufacture and sale of specialty portable barriers and barrier gate systems for flexible traffic management and incident response. These are physically produced and used for quick deployment and modification of road barriers.

products.name: Road Marking and Road Safety Equipment
products.description: Manufacture and sale of preformed tape for temporary road markings and a range of plastic and rubber road safety accessories for delineation, traffic calming, and signaling. Includes operation of a certified testing laboratory for highway safety products. These are physically produced and sold to road agencies and contractors.

products.name: Railroad Signals and Structures
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacture of products for the railroad industry, including signals, lights, structures, foundations, junction boxes, and signs. These are physically manufactured to industry standards and sold to railroad operators.

products.name: Commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) Insurance
products.description: Comprehensive insurance products for businesses of all sizes, including property, general liability, workers' compensation, automobile, umbrella, professional liability, management liability, cyber risk, environmental, and specialty coverages. Delivered through underwriting, risk management, and claims services, distributed via brokers, agents, and digital platforms.

products.name: Personal Property and Casualty (P&C) Insurance
products.description: Insurance products for individuals and families, especially high-net-worth clients, including homeowners, automobile, valuables, umbrella liability, cyber, travel, and recreational marine insurance. Delivered via underwriting and claims services, distributed through agents, brokers, and digital partnerships.

products.name: Agricultural Insurance
products.description: Insurance products for the agricultural sector, including federally subsidized Multiple Peril Crop Insurance (MPCI), crop-hail insurance, and farm and ranch/commercial agribusiness P&C coverages. Delivered through specialized underwriting and claims, distributed via agents and brokers.

products.name: Overseas General Insurance (International P&C and A&H)
products.description: International commercial and consumer insurance products, including property, casualty, specialty lines (D&O, cyber, aviation, marine, political risk), and personal lines (homeowners, auto, valuables, personal cyber). Delivered through global underwriting, claims, and digital platforms, distributed via brokers, agents, and direct channels.

products.name: Accident & Health (A&H) Insurance
products.description: Personal accident, supplemental health, disability, and travel insurance products for individuals, groups, and affinity programs. Delivered through underwriting and claims, distributed via agents, brokers, direct marketing, and digital channels.

products.name: Reinsurance (Property & Casualty and Life)
products.description: Traditional and specialty reinsurance products for primary insurers, including property catastrophe, casualty, and specialty reinsurance, as well as life reinsurance. Delivered through underwriting and risk assessment, distributed via reinsurance brokers and direct relationships globally.

products.name: Life Insurance and Savings Products
products.description: Individual and group life insurance, including term life, whole life, universal life, unit-linked, endowment, annuities, and savings products. Delivered through underwriting and investment management, distributed via tied agents, brokers, telemarketing, and bancassurance, primarily in Asia and select international markets.

products.name: Asset Management Services
products.description: Investment management services for institutional, pension, and retail mutual fund clients, including management of third-party assets and private loans. Delivered through licensed asset management subsidiaries, primarily in China, earning management and performance fees.
